purpose: Qualitative trichome-class and counter-method evaluation only; never model training or automatic harvest decisions.

classDefinitions.clear: A resolved intact gland head is transparent enough that internal or transmitted background detail remains visible without a clipped highlight.
classDefinitions.cloudy: A resolved intact gland head has diffuse milky or opaque interior appearance across the head rather than one small glowing reflection.
classDefinitions.amber: A resolved intact gland head contains yellow, orange, or brown color that can be separated from pistils, plant tissue, background, and lighting cast.
classDefinitions.amber_or_warm_light: A resolved intact head is yellow, orange, tan, or brown but the image cannot separate internal color from warm light or adjacent colored tissue.
classDefinitions.cloudy_or_glare: A resolved white-looking head cannot be separated from reflection, clipping, or focus loss.
classDefinitions.not_a_countable_head: Bright pixels, sparkles, pistils, plant hairs, colored tissue, blurred circles, compression artifacts, sugar-leaf edge heads, detached heads, and duplicate appearances in overlapping crops are excluded.

blockers: The rights-reviewed seed is small and contains collages rather than a diverse ordinary-phone corpus.
Most panels provide a qualitative class label, not per-head bounding boxes or independent counts.
The one exact-count reference contains colored annotation overlays and is not eligible as a blind recognition input.
Independent domain review and a staging-only evaluator run remain required before a model or prompt change is accepted.

separateMetrics: head detection precision, recall, and F1 at normalized-box IoU 0.5
resolved clear, cloudy, and amber class precision, recall, and F1
counterEvaluationGate.acceptance: Candidate amber F1 and recall must improve while detection F1, resolved-class macro F1, false-amber rate, and possible-amber coverage do not regress on the same blinded set.

methodEvidence.title: Estimating Cannabis Flower Maturity in Greenhouse Conditions Using Computer Vision
supports: split high-resolution phone-macro images into 512 by 512 patches
filter low-detail patches with a sharpness metric
detect trichomes before classifying individual padded head crops
evaluate detection and class accuracy separately
aggregate class counts at the sampled-flower level
doesNotSupply: public trained detector or classifier weights
permission to claim the paper's study-specific metrics for GrowPath
